shortDescription: Manage notes for findings, investigations, and response plan tasks

options.name: api_app
options.description: The app portion of the Splunk API path. Override this if your environment uses a different app name.

options.name: api_namespace
options.description: The namespace portion of the Splunk API path. Override this if your environment uses a different namespace.

options.name: api_user
options.description: The user portion of the Splunk API path. Override this if your environment requires a different user context.

options.name: content
options.description: The content/body of the note. Required when C(state=present) (creating or updating a note).

options.name: finding_ref_id
options.description: The reference ID of the finding to attach the note to. Required when C(target_type=finding). Format is typically C(uuid@@notable@@time{timestamp}).

options.name: investigation_ref_id
options.description: The investigation UUID. Required when C(target_type=investigation) or C(target_type=response_plan_task).

options.name: note_id
options.description: The ID of an existing note. Required when updating or deleting a note. When C(state=present) and C(note_id) is provided, the note is updated. When C(state=absent), C(note_id) is required to identify the note to delete.

options.name: phase_id
options.description: The ID of the phase containing the task. Required when C(target_type=response_plan_task).

options.name: response_plan_id
options.description: The ID of the applied response plan. Required when C(target_type=response_plan_task).

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the note. Use C(present) to create or update a note. Use C(absent) to delete a note (requires C(note_id)).

options.name: target_type
options.description: The type of object to attach the note to. Use C(finding) to attach a note to a security finding. Use C(investigation) to attach a note to an investigation. Use C(response_plan_task) to attach a note to a task within an applied response plan.

options.name: task_id
options.description: The ID of the task to attach the note to. Required when C(target_type=response_plan_task).
